options.title: Airbnb Sold Cereal for {fact1} a Box
options.first_line: Airbnb's founders once sold breakfast cereal at {fact1} a box, to keep their start-up alive.
options.first_frame: A typeset price list headed 'Airbnb' with the line 'Obama O's, one box: {fact1}' highlighted in yellow; then a cut to boxes of cereal on top of a fridge.

options.title: Airbnb Was Kept Alive by Boxes of Cereal
options.first_line: Airbnb was kept alive by a box of breakfast cereal.
options.first_frame: A typeset price list headed 'Airbnb' with the cereal line and its price highlighted; then a cut to boxes of cereal on a fridge with the Airbnb logo dropping in.

options.title: Investors Said No to Airbnb. So It Sold Cereal
options.first_line: Investors turned Airbnb down in 2008, so its founders started selling cereal.
options.first_frame: A typeset price list headed 'Airbnb' with the cereal box price highlighted; then a cut to an air mattress in an empty room.

why: A famous name plus a cereal box with a strange price makes a stranger ask why anyone paid that and how it saved Airbnb, and the price list says it all with the sound off.
